releaseNotes: OCR: Aadhaar DOB no longer picks up issue/print date
OCR: Scan back of Aadhaar/DL/Passport for address & PIN
OCR: Passport now supported as ID type
OCR: Card frame overlay shown during scan guidance
App resumes to last screen after biometric unlock
Receipts: Student name + ₹ symbol shown correctly
Receipts: Admin menu — edit notes, void (with reason), unvoid, delete
Void receipt now records reason in Firestore

studentFeatures.title: Smarter ID Scanning
studentFeatures.description: Scan front & back of Aadhaar, Driving Licence, or Passport. Address and PIN auto-fill from back side.

studentFeatures.title: Clearer Receipt View
studentFeatures.description: Receipts now show your name, ₹ amount, payment method, and validity dates at a glance.

studentFeatures.title: Resume Where You Left Off
studentFeatures.description: After biometric unlock, the app returns to exactly where you were — not the home screen.

adminFeatures.title: OCR — Passport Support Added
adminFeatures.description: Passport is now fully supported for student registration OCR — extracts name, DOB, passport number, nationality.

adminFeatures.title: Two-Sided ID Scanning
adminFeatures.description: After scanning the front, a 'Scan Back Side' button appears for Aadhaar/DL/Passport to capture address & PIN.

adminFeatures.title: Receipt Admin Controls
adminFeatures.description: Tap ⋮ on any receipt to: edit admin notes, void with a reason, unvoid, or delete. Void reason saved to Firestore.

adminFeatures.title: App Resumes to Last Screen
adminFeatures.description: After locking the screen or going to home, the app restores your last active page after biometric unlock.
